answer: Verifier first commits 64 GB of RAM for a probe window, hashing pseudo-random offsets against a nanosecond access budget over the memory bus; a real agent answers sequential proofs well within that bound, while a Sybil swarm multiplexing fake identities onto shared pages stalls at the horizon of contention. Each passing round mints a crystal-clear signed receipt chaining host latency to identity, and every failed probe drops the offender off the jetty into an unauthenticated pool.
